rows.name: UK-AIR Sensor Observation Service
rows.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
rows.semantic_limit: The machine-readable service exposes live in-situ sensor observations; sensor data cannot be interpolated to an exact parcel without validated station metadata and spatial methodology.
rows.evidence_basis: Official UK-AIR documentation describes an OGC Sensor Observation Service for sensors and air-quality archives in open machine-readable formats.

rows.name: AAIB Annual Safety Review 2025
rows.semantic_limit: Occurrence notifications, investigations and safety actions provide national aviation-safety context; they are not airport, flight-path or parcel-specific hazard measurements.
rows.evidence_basis: Official AAIB review summarises 2025 notifications, investigation classes, fatal-accident investigations, final reports, recommendations and safety actions.

rows.name: RAIB Annual Report 2025
rows.semantic_limit: National notification, examination and investigation totals support rail-safety calibration only; they cannot be attributed to an exact property or nearby railway segment without case-level evidence.
rows.evidence_basis: Official RAIB report covers 2025 operational activity, investigation outputs and recurring safety themes.

rows.name: MCA annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Agency strategy, KPI and governance reporting is held as institutional context and is not independent evidence of marine risk at a coast, port or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: Official MCA report covers activities, performance against key indicators, governance and accounts for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.

rows.name: MAIB current investigations register
rows.semantic_limit: The register identifies investigations and preliminary assessments, not established causation or generalised local risk; open cases must not be converted into parcel scores.
rows.evidence_basis: Official MAIB register lists current marine incidents, dates, descriptions and investigation status and records its latest update.
